name: Immunoglobulin D (IgD)
short_description: The "training-wheels" antibody of the naive B cell - a single T/Y-shaped monomer of two heavy (delta) and two light chains, co-expressed with IgM on the surface of every mature naive B cell via a short transmembrane anchor as part of the B-cell receptor, and marked by the longest, most flexible hinge of any human immunoglobulin.

textbook.1: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; unmistakable wide T-shape (not a compact IgG-style Y): two Fab arms each a 3-bead heavy+light chain string, a strikingly long thin extended hinge with a fine glycan fringe and one disulfide cross-link, a compact 3-bead Fc stem plugging into a short transmembrane anchor through a small local double-layer membrane strip - not a full enclosing cell; muted educational palette matching the house style, no text/border/face/organelles)

sem.1: fail (gemini-2.5-flash-image; molecular-cluster arm tips read as small-molecule ball-and-stick chemistry rather than a protein surface, and the glycan fringe was drawn along the whole arm instead of confined to the hinge, superseded)
sem.2: fail (gemini-2.5-flash-image; the hinge/Fc junction collapsed into a tangled knot-like mass instead of reading as a long extended hinge, understating IgD's defining feature, superseded)
sem.3: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; clean false-colour molecular-surface T-shape, correct heavy/light chain false-colour split along each arm, distinct bilobed Fc stem, short transmembrane segment through a small local double-layer membrane strip at the bottom edge - not a full cell; explicit in-prompt note that this is a stylised surface rendering, not a literal SEM claim; no baked text/border)

3d.1: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; wide T-shape topology, natural dusty teal/gold biological tints, visibly extended hinge with glycan fringe and a bright disulfide cross-link, compact Fc stem feeding into a transmembrane anchor seated on a small local membrane patch (rendered as a disc rather than a full enclosing cell) - no face/organelles/text)

watercolor.1: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; full-bleed aged-paper plate matching the cocci/rod-bacterium exemplar style, wide T-shape with 3-bead heavy+light chain arms, a distinctly long wavy hinge carrying fine ink-dot glycan marks and a cross-hatched disulfide mark, compact Fc stem into a small local membrane strip - no mat/frame/sheet-on-surface, no baked text)

reference: pass (RCSB PDB Structure Summary page image for PDB 1ZVO, CC0 1.0, auto-rendered ribbon diagram from the deposited solution-scattering coordinates of human myeloma IgD, Sun et al. 2005 J. Mol. decision: use as final; wide T-shape, long extended hinge with glycan fringe and disulfide mark, small local membrane strip, no full cell
